Therefore, it is not possible to find the exact model of this ATI controller card.

ATI Technologies Inc. was a Canadian semiconductor technology corporation that specialized in the development of graphics processing units (GPUs) and chipsets. It was founded in 1985 in Markham, Ontario, Canada. ATI was acquired by Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) in 2006, and the ATI brand name was phased out in 2010.

Given that ATI's primary products in the "Controller Cards" category were graphics cards, the closest possible identification is a generic ATI graphics controller card. ATI produced various lines of graphics cards, including the "Wonder" series (EGA Wonder, VGA Wonder), "Mach" series, "Rage" series, and the well-known "Radeon" series.
